name: チャンネルの表示を整えるパネル
prompt:
Create the second render of this same Japanese channel-selection panel. Preserve all exact Japanese wording, colors, icons and component hierarchy. The output canvas remains exactly 390x692 proportion. This is a geometry correction, not a redesign.

The top header, tabs and search in v001 are all about 8-15 logical pixels too low. Place them at the native positions: centered title 「チャンネルと役割」 near y15; tabs at x16 y66 and x200 y66, each about 174x32; search bar at x16 y112, about 358x40. Do not add status bar or outer screen chrome.

The onboarding card in v001 is too wide, too tall and too low. Set its pale-mint outer panel exactly around x30 y180 with width330 and height262 on the 390x692 canvas, leaving 30px side margins. Keep the gray close X, white illustration window, dark four-row graphic with green heart and red X, exact title 「表示するチャンネルを選ぶ」 and the exact three explanatory lines. Keep the current card typography and colors, but fit the contents inside the smaller native card.

Place the category label 「相談とアイデア」 near y480, with the empty checkbox and 「分類をフォロー」 at the native right position. Place row 1 「地域からのお知らせ」 with subtext 「5日前に活動」 near y529 and its forest-green selected checkbox at x340. Place row 2 「活動の相談」 and subtext 「地域の活動について相談する場所です。」 near y608 and its selected checkbox at x340. Move the category and both rows up to these native positions after correcting the card. Keep the two rows’ native spacing.

No hyperlink text appears in the Japanese panel. Keep all labels and channel names dark or muted as shown. If an actual hyperlink label is visible, render its linked words blue. The source English BETA pill is a status badge, not a hyperlink, and is excluded. Do not recolor the forest-green selected tab or checkboxes blue.

Use the native preview as exact authority for canvas size, vertical positions, Japanese copy and color. Use v001 only as a style reference; correct its wide/tall card and downward drift. Exclude footer, status bar, unrelated rows and other app chrome.
reviewNotes: v002を実画像で目視。日本語全コピー、タブ、検索、図版、カテゴリ、2行、選択状態を保持し、リンク文言なし。カード幅はnativeに近づいたが、高さが短く上端も少し高い。カテゴリと2行を上げすぎて、下段ほどnativeより上方へずれ、下部余白が過大になった。2回の限定試行を保存しneeds-correctionのまま次IDへ進む。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
